plugins.name: boutique-tc
plugins.description: Transaction-coordination assistant for The Boutique Real Estate Group. Turns an accepted contract into a fully set-up Follow Up Boss deal, drafts the transaction emails, answers what's still missing on a file, runs the daily sweep and inbox watch, keeps a live pipeline board, and learns the TC's email voice. Additive to FUB, drafts-only outbound, broker signs off.
